description: High Voltage Flexibility Zones by Tender Round is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction This dataset provides a geospatial view of High Voltage (HV) Flexibility Zones where long-term flexibility services have been tendered for by UK Power Networks. The dataset presents HV Flexibility Zones by tender round, showing whether UK Power Networks was procuring flexibility to manage constraints in a zone relating to high demand (e.g. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
